admission.justification: Binding server command, source, settings and intake prevents a role writing through another installed AR build.

applicability: Role launches whose runtime provider accepts tool-server definitions.
exclusions: Explicit supportsMcpServers=false withholds the definition and records that limit; no alternate harness configuration is created.
statement: A launch passes the runtime exactly one tool-server definition for the agent, under the fixed name `agents-remember-task`: the interpreter that runs the launching process, started with `-P -m agents_remember.mcp --config <the settings file the launching process was started with>`; AR writes and reads no harness configuration file.
